payload.posture: Read 1 Timothy 5:3–16 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states widows, households, enrollment, and communal care. Honor widows who are widows indeed. If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
